subject: Re: MAP Draft — NovaHealth (reforecast & milestone reprioritization)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: rafael_mendes, dev_patel

Subject: MAP Draft — NovaHealth (next steps & target close)

Hi Sophie / Carlos,

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier — great context on your priority care use case and the pilot goals. As discussed, attached is a first draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones, owners, and proposed target close. High level:

- Target close: 2026-09-30 (initial contract + pilot kick-off)
- Key milestones: evaluations (tech & security), pilot deployment, procurement sign-off, SOW/DocuSign
- Dependencies: SOC2 evidence/PII scoping, procurement window, internal IT network whitelisting

Action items in the draft:
- NovaHealth: provide SOC2 scope + point of contact for procurement (Carlos)
- Redwood: finalize pilot sizing and deliver SOW draft (Marissa)
- Solutions: technical runbook and environment checklist (Rafael)

Please review the attached (NovaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx) and call out any date/owner changes. If the 9/30 close is optimistic on your side, tell us and we'll reforecast — we want the MAP to reflect the most realistic path.

Next steps: can we schedule a 30-min sync next week to align on procurement timeline?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0134

Attachments: NovaHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx

From: Sophie Liang <sophie.liang@novahealth.com>

Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: 2026-08-30T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Draft — NovaHealth (next steps & target close)

Hey Marissa — thanks for the clear MAP. A couple of updates from our side after talking to procurement and IT: 

1) Procurement has a constrained window and won't be able to complete legal review until early November. That pushes any signature timelines out.
2) We'd like to deprioritize the full pilot integration until after the contract is executed — we'd rather sign and then kick off an expanded pilot in Q4.

Can you rework the MAP with a revised target close of 2026-11-15 and move the pilot milestone to post-signature? Also include a clearer list of the SOC2 evidence we need to share with procurement.

Quoted for context: On Fri, Aug 28, 2026 at 9:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> [original MAP draft attached]

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Liang
Head of Digital Transformation | NovaHealth

Hi Sophie — totally understood, thanks for the update. I've attached an updated MAP (NovaHealth_MAP_v2.xlsx) with the following changes per your ask: 

- New target close: 2026-11-15
- Pilot milestone moved to post-signature (Milestone 5)
- Procurement & Legal tasks expanded with a required SOC2 evidence checklist and KMS/encryption notes
- Owners updated: Procurement (Carlos), IT/Network (Sophie's IT lead), Technical Eval (Rafael), Pricing & SOW (Marissa)

Updated action items:
- NovaHealth: confirm procurement point of contact + SOC2 scope (by 2026-09-10)
- Redwood: prepare SOW draft and pricing worksheet (Marissa) by 2026-09-14
- Rafael: provide technical runbook & preflight checklist by 2026-09-07

I’ll schedule a 30-min alignment call for next week to walk through the MAP and the SOC2 checklist so procurement has everything they need. Rafael / Dev — can you confirm you can meet next Wed 9/8 at 10am PT?

DocuSign / SOW note: we'll prepare the SOW and share a DocuSign link when legal review window opens. Link placeholder included below.

Thanks,
Marissa
